rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-3 fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained breast (search-20260703-01), val_n=200. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) TRAJECTORY iter->ssim/psnr/rmse/hr: 1(relax0.5,init_t0.7)->0.7220/27.35/1.465e-2/0; 2(relax1.0,init_t0.7)->0.8199/27.62/1.420e-2/0. dc_relax0.5->1.0 lifted SSIM +0.098 and cut RMSE 3.1% but PSNR still ~8.7dB below the calibrated FBP baseline (~36.3) -> hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: even at full DC the recon starts reverse-diffusion at init_t=0.7, giving the 10x-out_scale-mis-normalised Mayo wavelet prior 8 Euler steps from a heavily-noised embed to drift HU away from the measured manifold before the terminal DC pins it; the per-step DPS + prior injection re-corrupts HU faster than one CG solve per step recovers. dc_relax axis is now saturated (relax1.0). (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.7 -> 0.4 (embed the FBP at a LOWER flow-time -> start closer to FBP, fewer/smaller reverse-diffusion perturbations for the mis-scaled prior to inject; the DC-anchored FBP structure is preserved). ALL else identical to iter-2 (steps8, eta1.0, dc1, n_cg5, relax1.0). PROVEN direction: the Mayo wdm-wavelet-constrained sibling's best converged at init_t0.4 (its iter-4 init_t0.7->0.4 was the run RMSE-down move), and the wavelet-UNCONstrained Mayo sibling hit run-best RMSE at init_t0.4. (4) HYPOTHESIS: init_t 0.7->0.4 cuts RMSE below iter-2's 1.420e-2 and raises PSNR toward baseline because less reverse-diffusion = less mis-scaled-prior HU drift, and full DC still enforces measurement consistency; SSIM holds >=0.82. hr may still be 0 (Mayo-prior-on-breast is likely FBP-bounded) but this is the strongest remaining RMSE-down axis. FALSIFIER: if RMSE >= 1.420e-2 (init_t INERT/worse under full DC), the prior term is already near-negligible at relax1.0 and the residual gap is the intrinsic sparse-view null-space the mis-scaled prior can't fill -> iter-4 lowers fd_recon_eta (cut DPS guidance so the mis-scaled score stops steering) and/or drops fd_recon_steps. (5) BUDGET: lower init_t executes FEWER reverse-diffusion steps -> runtime <= iter-2 130.6s, well inside 1200s budget / 1800s kill. val=ALL 200 seed-20260703 cases. (6) Loop continues; iter-4 self-dispatched on landing via numeric-RMSE gate.
